The '''Blobfish''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the submarine ride at the [[Night Market]], which takes place at [[The Beach]] during [[Winter]] 15-17.

In the submarine ride at the Night Market, there is a 10% chance to hook a Blobfish (20% if using a [[Curiosity Lure]]). If using Magic Bait in the southwest corner of the beach, there is a 3.3% chance to hook a Blobfish (10.2% if using a Curiosity Lure).<ref name="requirements"/>

The Blobfish and the [[Pufferfish]] are the only [[Fish#Fishing Pole Fish|fishing rod fishes]] that have a "floater" behavior in the fishing mini-game.

Blobfish can also be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]] — cast west from the left-most pier in the southwest corner of the beach.

==Tailoring==
Blobfish is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Blobfish Mask|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Blobfish can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 4 days.  The initial pond capacity is 1 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing four quests.  The primary output is beige Blobfish [[Roe]], but more valuable items are possible starting at population 9.

==Quests==
Blobfish is not used in any [[quests]].

==Notes==
* Due to the small size of the Submarine pond limiting its tiles' [[Fishing#Distance from Land|distance from land]], the Blobfish can only be caught at its maximum [[Fishing#Fish Size & Quality|Size]] of 26" when fishing on the Beach using Magic Bait.
